embeds.title: 🔴 WP Maps Pro Bug Exploited to Create Admin Accounts on WordPress Sites
embeds.description:
Hackers are exploiting CVE-2026-8732, a critical vulnerability in WP Maps Pro versions 6.1.0 and older, to create rogue administrator accounts on WordPress sites without authentication. Researchers at Wordfence report blocking over 3,600 exploitation attempts in 24 hours. The vulnerability stems from an unauthenticated AJAX endpoint that allows attackers to create new admin users and generate passwordless login URLs. A patch was released on May 20 as WP Maps Pro 6.1.1.
**Sources:** BleepingComputer • 🔴 1 corroborating
**CVEs:** CVE-2026-8732 • **Access:** Unauthenticated AJAX endpoint with ineffective nonce validation
**Incident date:** unknown • **Confidence:** claim
[Read source](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/wp-maps-pro-bug-exploited-to-create-admin-accounts-on-wordpress-sites/)
